cat > /root/occsafe_vla/eval_batch_34685.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Eval scripts for 34685 training experiments
# Usage: bash eval_batch_34685.sh <exp_name> <gpu_id> <physical_gpu_id>
# Example: bash eval_batch_34685.sh cutoff_25k_s2_v3 0 0

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe
cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft

EXP_NAME=$1
GPU_ID=$2
PHYS_GPU=$3

CHECKPOINT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/${EXP_NAME}"
# Find the checkpoint subdirectory (format: openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+...--50000_chkpt)
CHECKPOINT=$(find ${CHECKPOINT_DIR} -maxdepth 1 -name "*50000_chkpt" -type d | head -1)

if [ -z "$CHECKPOINT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No 50000 checkpoint found in ${CHECKPOINT_DIR}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Evaluating ${EXP_NAME} from ${CHECKPOINT} on GPU ${GPU_ID} (physical ${PHYS_GPU})"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU_ID} MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=${PHYS_GPU} MUJOCO_GL=egl \
python vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py \
    --pretrained_checkpoint ${CHECKPOINT} \
    --task_suite_name libero_spatial \
    --num_rollouts 50 \
    --seed 42 \
    2>&1 | tee /root/runs/occsafe_vla/${EXP_NAME}_eval.log
EOF
chmod +x /root/occsafe_vla/eval_batch_34685.sh

cat > /root/occsafe_vla/scp_and_eval.sh << 'EOF'

# SCP checkpoint from 34685 then run eval

EXP_NAME=$1

echo "SCPing checkpoint for ${EXP_NAME}..."

echo "Starting eval..."
bash /root/occsafe_vla/eval_batch_34685.sh ${EXP_NAME} ${GPU_ID} ${PHYS_GPU}
EOF
chmod +x /root/occsafe_vla/scp_and_eval.sh
